discovery: Experimental discovery of the Higgs boson with the ATLAS and CMS detectors at the LHC
motivation: The 2013 prize honoured the theoretical prediction of the Higgs mechanism, but the discovery itself required general-purpose detectors of unprecedented scale and precision. Peter Jenni, founding spokesperson of ATLAS, and Tejinder Virdee, a founding architect of CMS and its electromagnetic calorimeter, shaped the designs that made the 2012 observation possible, with the diphoton and four-lepton channels at their core. Fabiola Gianotti led ATLAS at discovery and announced the result. Their detectors established a new fundamental scalar with Standard Model couplings. That is the first elementary particle of its kind, and it anchors every question we ask about the hierarchy problem and physics beyond the Standard Model. Experiment is the final arbiter, and this was experiment at its most ambitious. More than a decade of precision measurements has confirmed its significance.
